title: 低雜訊放大器設計
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究雜訊匹配、增益與穩定性；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate noise matching, gain and stability. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「低雜訊放大器設計」的「熱雜訊底限：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「訊號診所：雜訊與錯頻」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Thermal-noise floor: model and design” in “Low-noise amplifier design”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Signal Clinic: Noise and Aliasing” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「熱雜訊底限」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for thermal-noise floor?
options: 可用熱雜訊功率為 kTB，頻寬增加會提高整合雜訊。
相同溫度下雜訊功率與頻寬無關。
相同衰減量放在哪一級都不影響總 NF。
optionsEn: Available thermal-noise power is kTB; wider bandwidth increases integrated noise.
Noise power at fixed temperature is independent of bandwidth.
An attenuator has the same NF effect at every position.
quiz.explanation: 可用熱雜訊功率為 kTB，頻寬增加會提高整合雜訊。 將頻寬加倍，檢查功率噪聲約增加 3 dB。
quiz.explanationEn: Available thermal-noise power is kTB; wider bandwidth increases integrated noise. Double bandwidth and check for about 3 dB more noise power.

steps.title: 熱雜訊底限：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「熱雜訊底限」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in thermal-noise floor, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。將頻寬加倍，檢查功率噪聲約增加 3 dB。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「可用熱雜訊功率為 kTB，頻寬增加會提高整合雜訊。」和待排除假說「相同溫度下雜訊功率與頻寬無關。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Double bandwidth and check for about 3 dB more noise power. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Available thermal-noise power is kTB; wider bandwidth increases integrated noise.” with the hypothesis to reject “Noise power at fixed temperature is independent of bandwidth.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：將頻寬加倍，檢查功率噪聲約增加 3 dB。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Double bandwidth and check for about 3 dB more noise power. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 將頻寬加倍，檢查功率噪聲約增加 3 dB。
steps.observationEn: Double bandwidth and check for about 3 dB more noise power.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：相同溫度下雜訊功率與頻寬無關。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。

steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：用弱訊號加強阻塞的假想輸入檢查兩個預算。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Check separate budgets for a weak signal plus a strong blocker. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 用弱訊號加強阻塞的假想輸入檢查兩個預算。

steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：最低 NF 元件必然有最佳阻塞容忍。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: The lowest-NF device necessarily has the best blocker tolerance. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.
